description: This file declares the VaapiVideoEncodeAccelerator class, which implements hardware-accelerated video encoding using VA-API for the Chromium project. It includes class definitions, member functions, and data structures related to video encoding, surfaces management, and interaction with VA-API wrappers.

classes.name: VaapiVideoEncodeAccelerator
classes.description: Implements hardware-accelerated video encoding using VA-API, managing surfaces, encoding jobs, and client interactions within Chromium.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the encoder with configuration, client, and media log.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Enqueues a video frame for encoding.

methods.name: UseOutputBitstreamBuffer
methods.description: Provides a bitstream buffer for encoded data.

methods.name: RequestEncodingParametersChange
methods.description: Requests change in encoding parameters like bitrate and framerate.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys the encoder instance.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the encoder, executing the callback when done.

methods.name: OnMemoryDump
methods.description: Provides memory dump information for profiling.
